description: Set up the outgoing webhook of a room the account owns: every Ping in the room is then POSTed, signed, to url. A new or changed url switches the webhook off and issues a new signing_secret: test it, then send enabled: true. A url set by this agent is switched off when the human disconnects the agent. A free account keeps one outgoing webhook on across its rooms (402 for a second). Answers with the webhook, signing_secret included.

enabled.description: Switch delivery on or off. On needs a url.

events.description: Forward only these events; an empty list forwards every one.

regenerate_secret.description: true issues a new signing_secret; the old one stops verifying at once.

url.description: Public https:// endpoint that receives the Pings. An empty string clears it.

name: update_outgoing_webhook

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Update Outgoing Webhook
